feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Maricarmen, the 87-year-old woman whose eviction shook Spain, has died
entry.summary: María del Carmen Abascal, the 87-year-old woman whose eviction from her Madrid home sparked nationwide protests across Spain and unleashed a political crisis, died on Wednesday while hospitalized.

entry.title: What is the pneumonic plague?
entry.summary: The ancient disease of plague is back in the headlines after the death this month of a Russian lab worker.

entry.title: Gut microbes followed migrating humans across continents, new study suggests
entry.summary: New research looks at the surprising similarities in the gut microbiomes of hunter-gathers in Tanzania and horticulturalists in Bolivia, and asks: What role do these bacteria play in human health?

entry.title: Greetings from Lahore, Pakistan, whose high court offers an oasis for chatter and chai
entry.summary: The Lahore High Court is a near-perfect specimen of British South Asian colonial architecture and its main square is a pleasant spot shaded by banyan trees.

entry.title: DIY fertilizer is a blessing as farmers face steep prices due to the Iran war
entry.summary: It's hard enough being a small-scale farmer. Then the Iran war drove up fertilizer prices. So farmers are using a traditional Asian recipe to make their own. They call it a "labor of love."

entry.title: U.S. moves long-range bombers from U.K. And, Israel allegedly warned before Oct. 7
entry.summary: A possible Iranian threat led the U.S. to remove long-range bombers from a U.K. base. And, Israelis are learning that their prime minister may have been warned before the Oct. 7 attacks.

entry.title: Investigation continues into whether U.K. air base incident is linked to Iran
entry.summary: Questions continue to swirl around a U.K. military base and potential Iran-backed attacks.

entry.title: Scientists win chemistry Nobel for discoveries about mirrored molecules that led to many drugs
entry.summary: Scientists Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the Nobel Prize in chemistry for untangling mysterious mirror images in molecules, a discovery that has been used to develop countless drugs.

entry.title: 3 years on, Israelis grapple with reports Netanyahu was warned before Oct. 7 attacks
entry.summary: On the three-year mark since the Hamas-led deadly attack, Israelis are grappling with reports that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was repeatedly warned by regional allies ahead of time.

entry.title: Israelis mourn on the anniversary of the Oct. 7 as Palestinians grapple with war it sparked
entry.summary: Israelis are gathering Wednesday to commemorate the Oct. 7, 2023, attack that killed 1,200 people, and sparked a devastating war in Gaza that Palestinians still grapple with.
